A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TRON and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–H. The complete material supports comparison despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original VideoQA experiments, sensitivity analyses, and Appendix H evaluations on CoQA, TriviaQA, VQA, and MMLU.

after.justification: v3 retains the original VideoQA experiments, sensitivity analyses, and text/image QA and MMLU results in Appendix H.

M1.justification: The sampling and identification stages, conformal scores, semantic clustering, and alternative reliability measure are unchanged. Algorithm 1 retains the same procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Video-MME, NExT-QA, MUSIC-AVQA, and MSVD, plus CoQA, TriviaQA, VQA, and MMLU in Appendix H. The audio-perturbation scenario also already appears in v2.

E2.justification: The MMLU comparison retains LAC against TRON for both LLaMA variants. The evaluated model roster and frequency-versus-semantic-diversity comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Reported splits, sample counts, model configurations, risk settings, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged, including Appendix H protocols. The added explanation of Silence Percentage documents the existing experiment rather than establishing a changed protocol.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same deduplication, audio-silencing, calibration-split, reliability-measure, and size-stratified miscoverage analyses. No new analytical question or experiment is introduced.

E5.justification: Appendix H retains the five-trial reporting for text QA and VQA, the same plotted uncertainty, and Table 3's parenthetical values. No additional runs, seeds, or statistical procedures are reported.

E6.justification: Figure 7(b) changes its numerical EER scale: at epsilon 0.19, the upper-bound line reads 0.271 in v2 and 0.19 in v3, changing the numerical interpretation of the curves. This is a reporting correction, not evidence of improved model performance. Tables 1–3 and the other plots retain their results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, equations, and Appendix B proofs are retained. Appendix A's added explanation of nonconformity scores and set-size intuition introduces no new formal result or derivation.

C1.justification: The conclusion modestly narrows applicability from 'any language generation tasks' to 'various language generation tasks' and points to existing Appendix H evidence. The abstract and introduction retain the principal contributions and guarantees.

C2.justification: The result interpretations, marginal-versus-conditional coverage discussion, exchangeability limitation, and finite-sample caveat remain unchanged. Appendix A elaborates the existing set-size interpretation without introducing a new mechanism or concrete applicability condition.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 newly defines Silence Percentage as the proportion of randomly muted audio segments, clarifying implementation of the existing perturbation experiment. Hardware, sampling temperature, NLI backbone, sample counts, and model-access information are retained.

R1.justification: Appendix C.1 expands attribution for the NLI equivalence procedure from Farquhar et al. to include Duan et al. and Lin et al., already cited elsewhere. The main research positioning is unchanged; publication-metadata updates do not add distinct works.

P1.justification: v3 adds acknowledgements, expands the SCP background explanation, clarifies audio silencing, and renames 'Conditional Miscoverage Rate' to 'Conditional Performance.' Author/contact text and reference presentation also change, while most prose and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The document-wide conversion to ICLR formatting changes front matter, headers, text width, spacing, and the sizing and placement of figures, tables, and appendix material. Figure 3's caption corrects 'duplication' to 'deduplication,' and Figure 7(b)'s EER axis is revised. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The corrected Figure 7(b) scale resolves an inconsistency between displayed EER and the stated risk bound. The audio-muting definition and caption/background clarifications also improve reporting and reproducibility. These are limited gains: the method, proofs, experimental coverage, and principal evidence remain essentially unchanged.
